channel.description: Latest articles from The Highland Times (thehighlandtimes.com)

item.title: Council Staff Dig Deep to Support Highland Hospice
item.description: Staff from The Highland Council have raised £1,640 for Highland Hospice through a festive bake sale and charity raffle, highlighting the generosity of council teams and their continued support for vital hospice care across the Highlands.The post Council Staff Dig Deep to Support Highland Hospice appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: All I Want For Christmas is This Ducati
item.description: Ducati has unveiled the Panigale V4 Márquez 2025 World Champion Replica, a 293 unit collector superbike celebrating MotoGP glory, factory pride, and cutting edge racing technology, in a Christmas season reveal that blends motorsport success with pure two wheeled desire.The post All I Want For Christmas is This Ducati appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Shoppers Hit With £71 Million in Delivery Surcharges This Year
item.description: Households in the Highlands and Islands have paid an estimated £71 million in delivery surcharges this year, with new figures prompting calls for the UK Government to step in and end extra costs that campaigners say unfairly penalise rural shoppers, particularly at Christmas. The post Shoppers Hit With £71 Million in Delivery Surcharges This Year appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Baby Box Ing Day as Scotland Marks 350,000 Milestone
item.description: Scotland has passed a major milestone with more than 350,000 Baby Boxes delivered since 2017, highlighting the impact of a universal programme designed to support families, reduce inequality, and give every newborn the best possible start in life.The post Baby Box Ing Day as Scotland Marks 350,000 Milestone appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Boxing Day Leftovers Come With a Food Safety Warning From Hygiene Expert
item.description: With Christmas Day over and fridges full across Scotland, a food hygiene expert is urging families to reheat Boxing Day leftovers safely, sharing clear advice on storage, temperatures, and best practice to protect health while reducing festive food waste.The post Boxing Day Leftovers Come With a Food Safety Warning From Hygiene Expert appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Inheritance Tax Threshold Lifted to £2.5m After Farming Campaign
item.description: Scottish family farms are set to benefit from a higher inheritance tax threshold after it was raised to £2.5m following a long campaign by NFU Scotland, easing pressure on farming families and reducing fears over the future viability of rural businesses.The post Inheritance Tax Threshold Lifted to £2.5m After Farming Campaign appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: 2025 on Track to be One of The UK’s Warmest Years on Record
item.description: New Met Office figures suggest 2025 is likely to rank among the UK’s warmest years on record, with average temperatures tracking ahead of 2022, highlighting the rapid pace of climate change and a growing pattern of record breaking warmth across recent decades.The post 2025 on Track to be One of The UK’s Warmest Years on Record appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Bus Fare Cap Pilot Set to Bring £2 Journeys Across The Highlands and Islands
item.description: A £2 bus fare cap pilot covering the Highlands, Moray, Argyll and island communities will launch in 2026 after Bus Users UK helped shape the scheme, aiming to cut travel costs, boost passenger numbers, and protect vital bus services across rural Scotland.The post Bus Fare Cap Pilot Set to Bring £2 Journeys Across The Highlands and Islands appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: The High Life Cleared for Take Off as Cult BBC Comedy Becomes a Scottish Stage Musical
item.description: The cult BBC comedy The High Life is returning as a new stage musical in 2026, reuniting its original cast and touring Scotland, with performances at Eden Court Inverness from 29 April to 2 May, bringing Air Scotia back to life for a new generation.The post The High Life Cleared for Take Off as Cult BBC Comedy Becomes a Scottish Stage Musical appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: NFU Scotland Urges Funding Clarity for Sea Eagle Scheme Ahead of 2026 Lambing
item.description: NFU Scotland is urging the Scottish Government to confirm funding for the Sea Eagle Management Scheme ahead of 2026 lambing, warning that continued uncertainty risks animal welfare, farm viability and confidence among hill farmers and crofters across upland Scotland.The post NFU Scotland Urges Funding Clarity for Sea Eagle Scheme Ahead of 2026 Lambing appeared first on The Highland Times.
